searchText: After checking again a couple of slots the only unexpected thing I see it that during the slots when we were self building we normally didn't receive any bid which is abnormal (unless you were withholding bids). We have a couple of change related to bid and proposer preferences processing that we will deploy soon and things should be better (we currently don't re-process bids and preferences that are queued for future processing which could be the reason)
